_readme: Every running track (no siding, yard, spur or crossover) of the TRA, the High Speed Rail, the Alishan Forest Railway and the metros and light rails, one way of the site's network each, with its kind (s surface, b bridge or viaduct, t tunnel) and its points as [longitude, latitude, height over the ground] in millionths of a degree and tenths of a metre, the first point as it is and each next the change from the one before. Made by tools/real-railways/extract_tracks.py (decision 402); do not edit.

official.attribution: 內政部國土測繪中心「臺灣鐵路」「高速鐵路」「捷運」

source.heights: 平坦地圖使用 flatOffsets：全網共用節點，以 200m 尺度柔化短橋與引道，再限制露天顯示坡度（臺鐵高鐵 2.5%、林鐵 6%、捷運 4%），保留 7m 交叉淨距，露天段不因柔化而被地下段拉低至地面以下。地下疊層維持原 8% 約束；上述均為顯示估計，不是實測標高。
